thread:
ria-docs: Heads-up I opened a docs PR to clarify quota visibility for multi-tenant orgs + added SDK examples showing how to opt into project-level labels for analytics. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4219
jess-eng: nice. is this purely docs or do APIs need to accept a new param?
ria-docs: docs only. we already support `X-Redwood-Quota-Label` header; the doc was missing examples and had an outdated note that implied labels affect billing tiers (they don't).
tom-prod: please make that "does not affect billing" line very explicit. we've had support tickets where customers thought project labels change billing buckets.
lina-ux: i'll suggest a compact callout box that says: "Labeling is for analytics/visibility only; billing is computed at the org level unless you have an explicit billing agreement." will push wording to the PR.
jess-eng: can you paste the curl + python examples here so I can run a quick integration test?
ria-docs: pasted in PR but here they are: curl:

`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Redwood-Quota-Label: project=alpha,env=staging" -d '{"prompt": "hi"}'`

python (requests):

`import requests
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', headers={ 'Authorization': f'Bearer {TOKEN}', 'X-Redwood-Quota-Label': 'project=alpha,env=staging' }, json={ 'prompt': 'hi' })
print(resp.status_code)`

jess-eng: thanks. running now. one quick ask: add the SDK snippet for Go as well, some platform customers asked for it.
ria-docs: on it. i'll add a tiny Go snippet showing header injection into the client.
ci-bot: CI started for branch docs/quota-visibility-examples — https://ci.redwood/2389/status
lina-ux: also caught a missing link to the usage dashboard; fixed that and updated the panel screenshot alt text for accessibility.
jess-eng: test passed locally, header is accepted and shows up in analytics as `label.project` and `label.env`. no changes to billing.
tom-prod: approve the wording change and UX callout. one more nit: can we add a one-line migration note for customers using `X-Label` older header? some folks still use it.
ria-docs: added a migration note and deprecation timeline (30 days). merging after CI green. thanks all :rocket:
